dt.note: implicit Euler, dt 0.1 min vs 0.025 min

job_a.reading: A C2 + C3 route in a 1:1 [13C6] / [12C6] pool leaves a mixed share of 2 q (1 - q) = 0.500 whatever its rate constants; D3's printed mixed cell is <= 1 % (+-1 % absolute). The full route misses by 49 sd (~1200 nats); at q = 0.45 - 0.55 the share is 0.495 - 0.500. A C2 + C3 share of the hexose MFT above f = 0.059 is excluded at 1.96 sd (the R1 + f R3 sensitivity: f = 0.1 predicts 0.050). Holds at every band corner: no rate constant enters. The one assumption: the two fragments come from independent molecules (no in-cage recombination of one glucose's own C2 and C3).
job_a.r4_as_written_against_d5: Structural, no run: R4-as-written has no Cys-hexose Amadori species, so it cannot carry the pool measured at 90 C (de Roos Table II) and at 145 C (Du 2024b, ~62 % of the cysteine within 10 min). Falsified at every band corner. R4' carries the pool as a sink and is not falsified on disk.
job_a.data_read: none: D3's '<= 1 %' cell and D5's existence statement are taken as the case quotes them; no TEST table was opened

notes: The mini-model's declared choices D-1 - D-15 are in the module docstring (src/m4_reduced_power.py); none sets a band from a scored or screened pot.

Required agreement is read as 'the verdict must hold if the world sits at either end': each layer form pins the coordinate in BOTH the generating and the scoring draw sets. The joint reading (truth over the whole band, scored under every pinned form at once) was not built; it can only lower these numbers.

Holm across arms is applied to the adequacy p-values of the favoured rival in a union design; the decision itself is an lppd difference with no p-value, so Holm has nothing else to act on (as in M3's power check).

The MGO loss law (Ea 47 / 121 / 20, orders 1 / 2) is not a coordinate: the only MGO in the mini-model is R0's C2 + C3 route, carried as a sink-free upper bound (Hofmann Tables 7 / 8 largest yields), which holds at every corner. R3 is not a rival of the power check (sec. 5.4 item 2 lists R0, R1, R2, R4', R5); its rejection is job (a)'s arithmetic.

R0 has no Cys-hexose Amadori species: in arm 3 the fed compound is inert under R0 (declared), and in arm 2 R0 has no route from a fed C6 dicarbonyl to MFT. R0 'pinned at B60' is its shipped constants; its nuisance coordinates (Cys -> H2S, 1-DG exits, downstream) are drawn from the same bands as every rival.

The N2 arm is O2-free (factor 0) as the spec states; a residual-O2 form (0.05) was added beyond the spec, because R5's glucosone needs O2 and degassing is never perfect. It is reported beside, not inside, the required agreement.

Shares are read only where the same cell's unlabelled MFT (NF) is >= 3 LOD (D-13). The adequacy check is a diagonal-Gaussian posterior-predictive chi-square over the read, non-censored values (posterior over draws, the e grid and each species' tau node); correlations between values are ignored (declared approximation).
pH is the label pH throughout (0.5 M phosphate, no drift), as the spec's out-of-scope list says; part A and the full network (W3) are out of scope.

The case's 'Hofmann's aqueous arm for (b)' is arm 1's air cells at 145 C (the same design); D1 / D2 floors are 1 % of the truth's lowest value (the declared transfer applied to synthetic data, so no printed value is read).

NOT BUILT AS WRITTEN: the density rule (exact, or MC with PSIS k-hat < 0.7 and ESS >= 100, else M3's SMC). The densities here are self-normalised importance estimates over the band prior (edge-weighted for the claim's f, D-15) and mostly fail k-hat / ESS. M3's SMC costs minutes per density and the check needs ~10^4 - 10^5 densities per form, so it was not run. The verdicts rest on |d| far beyond the MC error for structural contrasts, and on the half-set verdict check where |d| is near the threshold; cells with a high flip rate are flagged and should be read as uncertain to that extent.

NOT BUILT: a separate test of 'f moves with temperature' (constant f against the FM4 mixture). The spec's pairs are R1 vs R5, the claim vs R0 / R2 and R4' vs the claim; the 120 C cells are scored inside arm 1 for those, and 'arm1_no120' shows what they add.

Forms run at 2048 draws and R = 30 synthetic laboratories (Clopper-Pearson half-width up to ~0.18 at 0.5), on six designs; the primary at 4096 draws and R = 150 on every design. The demotion line (0.5) is read on the minimum over forms, so a form near 0.5 is a coarse reading.
